svg.title: Admin revised activity diagram
svg.desc: Current iPawcus workflow, reviewed 19 October 2026. Alternative activity branches use decisions and merges; actor labels identify responsibility.
svg.text: email verification, token, and role access
show case in assigned vet My List
Continue in Pet Intake for clinical
Capture and save the signed or
Post verified full payment in POS;
verify actual collection of the pet
Reserve / assign unit and check in;
or create a walk-in counter sale
consent, own profile, or Vet In/Out
Reception, physical examination, grooming, boarding, billing, stock, and controlled record/configuration work
Current local implementation reviewed: 19 October 2026 | Rounded box: activity | Diamond: decision / merge | Small label: responsible actor
Columns are alternative work areas. Merge diamonds combine alternatives; they do not wait for every activity to finish. Pending reviews may be revisited later.
Use the selected action's validation rules. For a timeout or uncertain write result, refresh the record before resubmitting. Leaving an activity returns to the menu.
Clinical handoff: Admin assignment creates a received vet assignment and places the queue in progress; My List reflects that assignment.
Saved consent and completed intake precede clinical finalization where intake storage is installed. Generic status edits cannot complete clinical work.
Refund handlers exist, but POS has no active Record Refund action. Grooming release follows verified full POS payment; staff still check actual collection.
